steps.title: Send me your product
steps.text: Ship me one sample. Set an affiliate commission on TikTok Shop. I focus on supplements and wellness products. My audience already buys these products.

steps.title: I create the content
steps.text: I make every review video myself: openings, product demonstration, and the opinion. A dedicated editor cuts to my spec. No agencies. No brand approval rounds. Filming starts after your sample arrives and the package is paid. I post on both accounts.

steps.title: You check every sale
steps.text: My videos go live on both accounts. You see every sale in your own TikTok Shop Seller Center. You do not need to trust my screenshots. You check the real numbers yourself.

partnership.heading: Ways to partner
partnership.sub: Three ways to work together. In every deal, I earn more when you sell more. Pick the priority level you want for your product.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.text: Five review videos on both accounts. You pay $5,000 upfront. I also earn TikTok Shop commission on every sale. A fixed first package if you want guaranteed videos without a larger volume commitment.
tiers.price: $5,000 for 5 videos · upfront + TikTok Shop commission

tiers.name: Retainer + Commission
tiers.text: A guaranteed number of review videos on both accounts. 100% upfront plus TikTok Shop commission on every sale. Month to month. No long-term contract.

tiers.name: Exclusive
tiers.text: Reserve one precisely defined product category for a 30-day period. I never promote competing products in that category. Paid upfront. Includes no videos — videos are purchased separately. Once your category is taken, it is closed.
tiers.price: $50,000 per 30-day period · per precisely defined product category · paid upfront · no videos included

partnership.note: Every deal pays me the most when your product sells. I win only when you win. I am one person, not an agency. So I keep a strict limit: four new products each month, no more. You could mail samples to one hundred small creators. That gets you one hundred small tests. Or you could work with the #1 affiliate in your category. That gets you a clear result in the first week. When the month is full, the next spot goes to the product that fits best. Supplement and wellness brands always come first. Need more than 30 videos? Contact us for custom volume pricing.

contact.heading: Work with me
contact.subheading: Tell me about your product: your TikTok Shop link, your category, and the commission you can offer. I accept at most four new products each month. Slots go to the products that fit best. I reply to every brand inquiry within 24 hours. The person who replies is the person who makes your videos. If your product fits, the next step is a short call. On the call, I show you my live sales dashboards.

faq.heading: Questions brands ask

items.q: How fast is the first video?
items.a: After your sample arrives and the package is paid, I film on the next production days and post on both accounts. Retainer partners get a guaranteed number of videos.
It depends on your product price and your profit margin.
bullets: Most products I accept pay **20–35%** commission on TikTok Shop
Higher rates get priority in my posting schedule
Performance bonuses move you to the top of the list for your category

items.a: **Yes to talking points. No to approvals.** Send me your key points. I will read every word. But I do not send drafts. I do not re-film after brand notes. The video goes straight from my camera to my audience. Here is why: when brands edit videos, the videos feel like ads. Ads do not sell on TikTok Shop. Every number on this page comes from working this way.

Every package is paid upfront and includes TikTok Shop commission, so I still earn more when you sell more. I do not stop after one video. I test different openings and styles. Some products need three videos before one becomes a top seller. My biggest winner took more than 200 videos across two years. If a product does not fit my audience, I will tell you directly. That saves time for both of us.
Pricing is by package, **paid upfront**, plus TikTok Shop commission. We agree on the video count before we start:
bullets: 100% upfront + TikTok Shop commission. Month to month — no long-term contract.

items.q: What does my retainer actually guarantee?
items.a: Your retainer buys a **guaranteed number of review videos**. We agree on the count before we start. I post them on both accounts, every month, on schedule.
bullets: You check every attributed sale in your own TikTok Shop Seller Center
Invoices come from **Hammad Media LLC**, a registered US company
Month to month — you can stop after one month

items.q: How does the Exclusive tier work?
items.a: Exclusivity reserves one **precisely defined product category** for a **30-day period**. **$50,000** per 30-day period, **paid upfront**. No videos are included — videos are purchased separately.
bullets: **Per category, not the whole vertical** — you reserve a precisely defined product category, such as collagen. I never promote competing products in that category.
Includes **no videos**. Video packages are purchased separately.
Paid upfront. 30-day period. Once your category is taken, it is closed.

items.q: Can we run your videos as ads?
items.a: Yes — through TikTok Spark Ads. I give you an authorization code. You can then boost any of my videos as an ad from my own handle. This works better than posting the video file on your brand account. You can also use my videos in your GMV Max campaigns. We agree on ad usage rights in each deal. If ad usage matters to you, say so in your inquiry. I will include it in the offer.

items.q: Our team is not based in the US — can we still work together?
items.a: Yes. Many of my partners run TikTok Shop US from outside the US. The process is simple. You ship the sample from your US warehouse. We agree on terms over email. For retainers, Hammad Media LLC sends you an invoice. It is a registered US company. You pay upfront by bank transfer. You pay the package upfront by invoice from Hammad Media LLC. TikTok Shop pays my affiliate commission automatically on attributed sales.

faq.sub: Clear answers. The same answers I give on every call.
